title: How to Fix South Korea-Ukraine Relations
author: Jason Cox
text:
Credit: Gemini Generated Image
The transfer of two North Korean soldiers to South Korea was intended to be a quiet diplomatic success. Ukraine captured them in January 2025 while they were fighting for Russia in the Kursk region. After months of bilateral talks, they arrived in South Korea in mid-September. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced the transfer at the U.N. General Assembly on September 23. That started a spat that culminated in South Korea recalling its ambassador to Ukraine on October 8, its first protest recall since 2008. Seoul is still demanding acknowledgment and an apology, while Kyiv considers the matter closed. On October 20, Seoul announced plans to withdraw roughly half its embassy personnel, citing what it described as Ukraine’s failure to take constructive steps to resolve the dispute.[...]
